set -euo pipefail

cd /workspace/repo

mkdir -p /workspace/.scotty/logs

  setsid nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 > /workspace/.scotty/logs/vite.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
fi

until curl -fs localhost:5173 > /dev/null; do
  sleep 1
done
